LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

RESOLVED ACTIVITIES:

1. Supplier financial health monitoring (90d):
   - No specific resource found; likely future enhancement

2. Ledger vs. supply chain discrepancy flagging:
   - MATCH: sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1
   - 3-way matching (invoice → PO → contract), flags exceptions

3. Employee engagement monitoring (Slack/email):
   - NO MATCH - Activity requires communication analytics not in landscape

4. Flight-risk employee early warning (predictive, 60d lead):
   - NO MATCH - Activity requires predictive HR analytics not in landscape

5. Regulatory rule matching to vendor agreements:
   - MATCH: sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1
   - Automates vendor safety compliance verification across contracts

6. Real-time cash flow visibility (hour-by-hour projections, alerts):
   - NO MATCH - No treasury/liquidity/cash flow forecasting resources in landscape

7. Dynamic pricing band order flagging:
   - NO MATCH - Landscape has order mgmt and invoice reconciliation, but no price band validation

8. Sales discount audit with threshold validation (customer segments, margin targets):
   - NO MATCH - sap.crm has sales/opportunity agents (qualification, compensation, campaign); sap.s4 has order automation
   - Missing: pre-order discount governance, segment-level threshold enforcement, margin verification before accounting

9. Turnover velocity trends to identify slow-moving/obsolete SKUs:
   - NO MATCH - Landscape has procurement/order/invoice/quality agents but no inventory analytics
   - Missing: Inventory turnover velocity trend analysis, slow-SKU detection, inventory aging forecasting
   - Explored: sap.s4 (order mgmt, BOM), my.mes (quality/manufacturing), sap.ariba (invoice/procurement)

10. SKU clearance protocols & safety stock optimization:
    - NO MATCH - Activity requires inventory management, clearance workflows, and dynamic safety stock adjustment
    - Missing: SKU clearance/disposal protocols, safety stock level adjustment, inventory optimization agents
    - Explored: sap.s4 (procurement matching, BOM compliance, order automation—no inventory mgmt), my.mes (quality/production/BOM validation—no inventory mgmt)
    - Confirmed: No dedicated inventory management/analytics system in landscape

11. Diversity spend monitoring by business unit & fiscal quarter:
    - NO MATCH - Activity requires diversity supplier spend tracking with contractual target monitoring
    - Missing: Diversity supplier spend analytics, minority/women-owned supplier tracking, target enforcement by BU/quarter
    - Explored: sap.ariba (invoice reconciliation, vendor compliance—focused on safety/safety; no diversity tracking), sap.ehs (compliance orchestration—focused on safety; no diversity monitoring), sap.s4 (procurement matching, BOM—no diversity spend)
    - Confirmed: No diversity spend monitoring or diversity supplier analytics in landscape

12. Wiki policy/procedure synchronization (flag outdated references when source systems update):
    - NO MATCH - Landscape lacks knowledge management/content synchronization capabilities
    - Missing: Wiki/knowledge base system, documentation sync agents, policy change detection, content cross-referencing, automated flagging of stale docs
    - Explored: corp.itsm (incident analysis, asset provisioning, change mgmt—no knowledge mgmt), sap.odm (entity taxonomy only, no resources)
    - Confirmed: No dedicated knowledge management or content synchronization system in landscape

13. Hedging recommendation engine (payment date-driven, not spot rate-based):
    - NO MATCH - Activity requires treasury/FX hedging capability with payment date forecasting
    - Missing: Currency/commodity hedging strategies, payment date-aware hedging recommendations, treasury risk management, hedging action recommendations
    - Verified: sap.s4 covers Procurement, Order Mgmt, BOM Compliance, Asset Lifecycle, Order Automation—no treasury/hedging
    - Confirmed: Landscape lacks treasury/financial hedging capabilities (similar to activity #6 cash flow forecasting)

Key systems:
- sap.s4: ERP (Procurement, Order Mgmt, Safety, Asset Lifecycle); OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine does order creation
- sap.crm: Sales/opportunity mgmt (qualification, compensation orchestration)
- sap.ariba: Procurement/vendor reconciliation (post-order invoice matching, material coordination, hazardous material tracking)
- sap.ehs: EHS/Regulatory compliance (safety incidents, vendor safety compliance, compliance campaigns)
